Write a practical notice for a fictional community tool library: reserve tools online, bring identification, and report damage before returning them. Avoid a marketing tone. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content:
**Maple Street Tool Library: Borrowing Notice**

Reserve tools online before visiting. Walk-in loans depend on availability. Bring photo identification when picking up any tool. If a tool is damaged or missing parts, report it through your account or at the front desk before returning it. Please do not return damaged tools to the shelves.
